# Psalm 12 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 12:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. Upon the-eighth. A-psalm of-David.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. According to the Sheminith. A psalm of David.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. According to the Sheminith. A psalm of David.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 12:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Save, YHWH, for the-faithful-one has-ceased; for the-trustworthy have-vanished from-among the-sons of-man.
- **LOGOS:** Save, O LORD, for the godly one is gone; for the faithful have vanished from among the children of man.
- **PNEUMA:** Help, LORD! The faithful are disappearing! Trustworthy people have vanished from the earth!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 12:6 (overlap: 5%)

- **LOGOS:** 'Because the poor are plundered, because the needy groan, I will now arise,' says the LORD. 'I will place him in the safety for which he longs.'
- **PNEUMA:** 'Because the poor are being crushed and the needy are groaning, I will now act,' declares the LORD. 'I will protect them as they have longed for.'

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** Emptiness they-speak, each to-his-neighbor; [with] a-lip of-smoothness, with-a-heart and-a-heart they-speak.
- **LOGOS:** Everyone utters lies to his neighbor; with flattering lips and a double heart they speak.
- **PNEUMA:** Everyone lies to their neighbors; they flatter with their lips while harboring deception in their hearts.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
